mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost per square foot for natural stone pool deck installation in the Los Angeles area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost per square foot for natural stone pool deck installation in the Los Angeles area can vary significantly, generally ranging from $25 to $75 or more. This range depends on the type of stone chosen, the complexity of the design, site accessibility, and existing ground conditions. High-end or custom cuts, intricate patterns, and specific finishes can increase the price. This estimate usually includes materials, labor, and basic site preparation, but detailed quotes are provided after a site visit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for natural stone pool deck installation in Los Angeles typically range from $25 to $75+ per square foot, depending on stone type, design, and site complexity.
